reviews.title: Great cooling capability
reviews.comment:
This is a really great value AIO . Keeps temp stable and performs really well . Best bang for your buck . Funny thing is , I bought this for an intel I7 cpu, and a few weeks later swapped to AM5 and was still able to keep the same AIO and didn’t have to buy no extra parts , the compatibility with this item is great aswell
Just wanna add more on how great this AIO is . I’ve now overlocked my ryzen 5 7600x and at 100% load I have yet to reach 70° . I will be buying the 360m version since I have the extra space , this was originally in a smaller case

reviews.title: Awesome AIO that can be mounted to the bottom of your case!
reviews.comment:
Price to performance is absolutely ridiculous...the cheapest AIO I have seen and some  of the best performance I've seen...Only thing I think that may be better for the price is the Deepcool LT520/LS520 series coolers, but it's very, very close.
I needed a cooler for this particular build that can be oriented in 2 different ways, one of which and the best orientation for airflow/cooling that would have the radiator mounted at the bottom.  For the vast majority of AIOs this is a big no no as air will get caught in the highest point of the loop, which would be in the CPU block where most AIOs also have the Pump installed.  This has the pump installed on the tubes close to the radiator making it totally safe for the radiator to be mounted on the bottom.  So now , regardless of the orientation of the case, the AIO will work just as good without possibly compromising the pump.
All things considered, versatility, performance, price, and looks, this is definitely high up on the list of best overall AIO liquid coolers.
The fans come pre-installed on the radiator in exhaust orientation.  Installation on AM5 was a breeze and used the clips already present on the motherboard to attach.  Radiator mounts the same as any other.

reviews.title: Installation is a pain
reviews.comment: This unit cools well and looks great, but the installation instructions (or lack thereof) are relatively hard to follow. The mounting system was simple enough, but the latch to the AMD mounting bracket was unnecessarily difficult to get attached. Still, a great value.

reviews.title: Incredible value
reviews.comment: Worked like a charm right away, including the colors when plugged in with the MB 3 pin connector. My only gripe is that the Y splitter for the fans power cable is a bit short, luckily I had a longer one from my previous build. Anyways CPU temperatures are quite low and it’s also not loud at all.
